actions.reason: apply_merges used to rebuild the full pair-rank list (a tuple and a dict lookup for every position) after every merge step. Now it builds the list once and only recomputes the ranks next to each merged occurrence. Untouched stretches of ids and ranks are copied with slices. Occurrences are found with ranks.index/count in the same left-to-right, non-overlapping order as merge(), and the exact pair is checked, so the output is identical. Equivalence harness: identical outputs. encode_ir ratio 0.733; train_ir is flat (1.0016).
